# Getting help

- **A question** (how do I, why does it): [Discussions, Q&A](https://github.com/RadishSoftware/mobster/discussions/categories/q-a). Check [Troubleshooting](https://docs.mobster.dev/troubleshooting) first; it is arranged by symptom.
- **A bug** in Mobster CLI: [open a bug report](https://github.com/RadishSoftware/mobster/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with the output of `mobster doctor --json`.
- **Your iPhone isn't detected, or setup stops**: the [device problem or report](https://github.com/RadishSoftware/mobster/issues/new?template=device.yml) form.
- **A security problem**: report it privately, as [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/RadishSoftware/mobster/blob/main/SECURITY.md) describes. Never in a public issue.
- **Mobster for Mac** (the paid app, its license and billing): email support@radish.software.
